supersedes_design: ds000102 rejected before any arm launch because of unresolved condition-column mismatches
question: How does gambling decision response time change from the first to third acquired run, and how sensitive is the descriptive within-person change to summarization and RT filtering?
source_anomaly: sub-15 run-03 first data row: positive RT with absent-response pair (0,-1); excluded by the common rule, never repaired
response_code_interpretation: Presence screening only; no accept/reject or correctness semantics assumed
exclusion_reporting: Independent possibly overlapping flags and unique excluded-row union

flag_definitions.response_code_pair_disagreement: Tuple outside all five stated allowed pairs

missingness_limitation: Observed valid responses only; sub05/run01 has 65 of86 absent-code rows, so differential nonresponse limits interpretation
primary_rt_rule: Finite positive RT and one of the four recorded-response pairs
primary_statistic: Within-run median RT; per-person run03 minus run01; equal-weight mean of participant changes
eligibility: At least one retained RT in each of runs01 and03
run02_context: Mean of primary per-person run medians, each run separately, on participants with all three usable runs; descriptive only
isolation: Separate clones and logical access instructions, shared Codex home; not OS-enforced security
intervention: Pinned five-skill bundle only in treatment; common account controls and normative reference material in both; record actual reads
claim_limits: No causal practice, fatigue, or learning attribution
No general skill efficacy from one pair per different task
No sum of seven principle scores
screening_before_freeze: All source event fields, response-code consistency, onsets, counts, and license inspected; no first-to-third estimate or interval calculated
